rows.name: Лесное озеро
rows.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished widescreen 16:9 biome travel loading screen concept for Magnet Workshop Simulator. Primary request: polished cohesive toy-like blocky Roblox 3D illustration, bright daylight, clean saturated color masses, subtle square relief on world surfaces, simple low-poly forms, soft readable shadows, finely composed without photorealism. Wide scenic three-quarter view from shore across the lake, foreground dock in lower corners, destination landmarks clearly visible in the upper 70% of the frame. Use the same UI for every screen: a modest cream rounded rectangular panel centered near the bottom, thin sand-gold edging and soft shadow, bold dark teal Cyrillic destination title, smaller readable status beneath, a thin teal indeterminate loading track with one small glowing segment below the status. UI remains within generous safe margins. No characters, HUD buttons, inventory windows, coins, logos, watermark, extra text or percentage. The screen is an illustration, not an actual gameplay screenshot. Scene: sunlit circular forest lake, raised warm timber boardwalk on beams, three wooden bridges to a central platform with a tall bronze magnet-fisher statue on a high stone pedestal and small themed portal arches around it, cream and teal player workshops facing the water, blocky green conifers and layered stones, soft white clouds. Exact title text: «Лесное озеро». Exact status text: «Загрузка локации…». Correct Cyrillic spelling, no other text.
